LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_OfferText1: A Tok'ra cell needs {0} {1} of {2} quality or better. The request was selected from work the colony can presently undertake. If accepted, a concealed rendezvous will be exposed. The offer remains open for about {3} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_OfferText2: The secure channel carries a practical request rather than an intelligence report: produce {0} {1}, each at least {2} quality, and deliver them to a temporary Tok'ra base. The cell will wait about {3} hours for an answer.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_OfferText3: A nearby Tok'ra group has exhausted part of its field supplies. It asks the colony to manufacture {0} {1} at {2} quality or better. Accepting will reveal a short-lived delivery point. The offer expires in about {3} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_OfferExpir: The Tok'ra production request has been withdrawn before the colony committed to it.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_Accepted: {0} has accepted the request for {1} {2} at {3} quality or better. The temporary rendezvous will remain available for about {4} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_SuccessTex: The caravan has delivered {0} {1} to the concealed Tok'ra position. The cell closes the route and acknowledges the colony's reliability.
The requested shipment of {0} {1} has reached the temporary base. The Tok'ra dismantle the rendezvous after recording the successful handoff.
The field team has received all {0} {1}. The hidden supply route disappears again, but the completed contract strengthens Tok'ra confidence in the colony.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_SpawnFaile: The Tok'ra cannot establish a safe temporary rendezvous. The request remains open.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_TargetLett: A concealed Tok'ra delivery point has appeared on the world map. Bring {0} {1} at {2} quality or better before the route closes in about {3} hours.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_FailureTim: The Tok'ra route closed before {0} {1} reached the rendezvous. The cell abandons the contract.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_FailureSit: The temporary Tok'ra position receiving {0} {1} can no longer be reached. The delivery is lost.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_TrustSucce: The Tok'ra record the colony as a dependable source of field supplies.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_TrustFaile: The Tok'ra become more cautious about relying on the colony's production commitments.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InspectPen: Requested shipment: {0} {1}, {2} quality or better. About {3} hours remain.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InspectSuc: The requested shipment has been delivered.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InspectFai: The temporary delivery contract has failed.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_AlreadyRes: This delivery contract is no longer active.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InvalidCon: The requested cargo can no longer be identified.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_NotEnoughC: The caravan carries only {0} of the {1} required {2} that meet the contract.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_RequiresCa: A player caravan must be present at the Tok'ra rendezvous.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_TransferFa: The cargo could not be transferred from the caravan.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_DebugForce: Forced a Tok'ra production and delivery request.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_ArrivedAtR: The caravan has reached the concealed rendezvous. Select it and use the handoff command when the requested cargo is ready.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_DeliverCom: Transfer {0} {1} of {2} quality or better to the Tok'ra contact. Only conforming goods will be taken.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_StatusLate: Late delivery: {0} {1}, {2}+ ({3} h before route closure)
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_LateWarnin: The agreed delivery window for {0} {1} has closed. The Tok'ra are holding the concealed route open for about {2} more hours, but a late handoff will earn less confidence.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_LateSucces: The caravan delivered {0} {1} after the agreed deadline. The Tok'ra accept the shipment, but the delayed handoff earns only limited confidence.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_TrustSucce: The Tok'ra accept the overdue shipment while noting that the colony missed the agreed window.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_FailureGra: The Tok'ra held the route open beyond the agreed deadline, but the {0} {1} still did not arrive. The cell abandons the contract.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InspectLat: Requested shipment: {0} {1}, {2} quality or better. The delivery is late; about {3} hours of emergency access remain.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_DebugLateW: Moved the active Tok'ra delivery into its late grace window.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_DebugInter: Armed the active Tok'ra delivery interception. It will trigger when a loaded caravan is traveling to the rendezvous.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_DebugDesti: The final approach to the active Tok'ra delivery point is now compromised. The first fully loaded caravan entering the last tile of the route will be attacked.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_Destinatio: Hostile movement blocks the final approach to the Tok'ra rendezvous. The shipment cannot continue until the route is secure.
The approach to the Tok'ra rendezvous is not secure. Resolve the hostile encounter and reform the caravan before continuing to the handoff.
The compromised approach is secure again. Reform the caravan with any recovered equipment, then continue to the Tok'ra rendezvous.
LanguageData.GR_TokraTemporaryBaseDelivery_InspectCom: The final approach to the rendezvous has been compromised. Clear the hostile encounter, reform the caravan and continue to the delivery point.
